# Vendored fonts

Latin subsets fetched from Google Fonts on 2026-10-12, so the sting renders without a
network fetch. Both are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org); each file carries its copyright and licence URL in its
name table.

| File | Face | Copyright |
|---|---|---|
| `anton-latin.woff2` | Anton 400, version 2.116 | Copyright 2020 The Anton Project Authors |
| `jetbrains-mono-latin.woff2` | JetBrains Mono Medium 500, version 2.211 | Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors |
